---
title: "Style"
---

/\* Sage Green Aesthetic \*/

body { background-color: #f6f9f6; /\* pale sage \*/ font-family: "Helvetica", sans-serif; }

.navbar { background-color: #9fb89f !important; /\* sage green \*/ }

h1, h2, h3 { color: #8aa88a; /\* softer sage for headings \*/ }

.profile-pic { width: 250px; height: 250px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); }

.centered { text-align: center; }
